# Beespoke Outbound Lead Generation

> Beespoke is a founder-led B2B outbound lead generation agency based in Barcelona. It helps focused B2B companies define an ideal-customer profile, research accounts and buying roles, run human-reviewed LinkedIn-led outreach, handle first replies, qualify interest, and book sales meetings. Beespoke was founded in 2025 by Noah Levy and operates as a four-person team.

Canonical company facts: https://outbound-lead-generation.com/ai-instructions/
Homepage: https://outbound-lead-generation.com/
